prompt_text: Who does backflow testing and repair near Liberty MO?
answer_verbatim:
I can’t look up live listings from here, but I can tell you where to find qualified backflow testers/repairers near Liberty, MO and how to pick one.

Who normally does backflow testing and repair
- Licensed plumbers who are certified backflow testers
- Irrigation/sprinkler companies (they commonly test the irrigation backflow preventers)
- Fire-protection contractors (for backflow on fire lines)
- Specialty backflow companies

Where to find them
- City of Liberty Water Department or utilities — many cities publish an approved/registered tester list or will accept test certifications from certified testers. Contact them to ask about local testers and city reporting requirements.
- Missouri Department of Natural Resources or local county resources — for state/local certification requirements.
- Local search: Google Maps / “backflow testing Liberty MO” / “backflow tester near 64068” / Angi / HomeAdvisor / Yelp
- National plumbing franchises that operate in KC area (e.g., Roto-Rooter, Mr. Rooter, Rescue Rooter) often provide testing and repair.

What to verify before hiring
- They are a certified backflow tester in Missouri (ask for tester certification number)
- They have insurance and a business license
- They will provide a written test report and submit it to the City of Liberty if required
- Experience with your device type (double-check valve, RPZ, reduced pressure principle assembly, etc.)
- Warranty on repairs and parts

Typical cost and timing
- Testing: commonly $50–$150 per device (depends on device size/type and local rates)
- Repairs: costs vary by parts/labor; get an estimate before work
- Many testers can both test and perform on-site repairs if needed

Sample questions to ask when you call
- “Are you certified to test backflow devices in Missouri? What is your certification number?”
- “Can you test and, if necessary, repair an RPZ/double-check/pressure vacuum breaker?”
- “Will you provide the official test report and submit it to the City of Liberty?”
- “What are your rates for testing and for common repairs/parts?”

If you’d like, tell me:
- Your ZIP code or street address (or just ZIP), and whether it’s a residential irrigation device, commercial domestic device, or fire line device — I can draft a short list of exact search queries and a phone/email script you can use to contact local companies. If you want me to produce specific local company names I can’t fetch live data, but I can show you the best way to search and vet results.
